question.prompt: A slope has a slope ratio of \(3:4\) and a length along its surface of 50 m. Find its vertical height. (Unit: m)

solutions.explanation: Let the vertical height be \(3k\) and the horizontal width be \(4k\). Then the length along the slope is \(5k=50\), so \(k=10\), and the vertical height is 30 m.
solutions.title: Proportional legs and the Pythagorean theorem
